title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 海外生活を夢見て、仕事と同時<u>並行</u>で、語学学校でスペイン語の勉強を始めた<u>さなか</u>、感染症の世界的な流行で<u>渡航</u>ができなくなった。私の夢は<u>粉々に</u>打ち砕かれてしまったが、<u>ぐずぐず</u>言っていても仕方がないと思い、日々語学学習に励んでいる。
english_translation: I had dreams of living abroad and was in the middle of starting to study Spanish at a language school in parallel with working when a worldwide infectious disease epidemic stopped me from traveling. My dreams of living abroad were shattered to pieces, but there's no point complaining grouchily about it, so I'm working hard every day to learn the language.
